headline: Navy Veteran Gets Life-Changing Gift: Refurbished Car from Student Mechanics
meta_description: A disabled Navy veteran in Minneapolis receives a beautifully restored 2020 Hyundai Elantra from auto collision students, transforming his daily life.
summary_short: After two years without a car, Robert Hanson—a Navy veteran with severe health conditions—received a refurbished 2020 Hyundai Elantra from Dunwoody College students.
body:
Robert Hanson, a US Navy veteran who flew as an airman from 1993 to 1997, recently received a transformational gift that he describes as a "big-time game changer." Students at Dunwoody College of Engineering's Automotive Collision and Refinishing program in Minneapolis spent months refurbishing a donated 2020 Hyundai Elantra for Hanson through the Recycled Rides for Schools program, a nonprofit initiative of the National Auto Body Council. For over two years, Hanson had managed without a car despite numerous errands and appointments. His severe asthma and fibromyalgia make public transportation extremely difficult, leaving him to walk everywhere just to buy groceries. After being referred to the program by a Hennepin County welfare service, he received the fully restored vehicle at the college.

The Elantra had arrived as damaged goods—donated by Allstate after a significant collision that had removed a substantial portion of its front end. The auto collision students transformed it into something entirely new, giving them rare visibility into the real-world impact of their classwork. "I was so happy to see that he was happy to have literally a brand-new car, and we were able to be a part of that," said collision student Abbie Vera.

For Hanson, the restoration means far more than transportation. "I've been walking everywhere to get food," he explained. "Now I can finally shop at more reasonable places and buy in bulk, and whatever you need a vehicle for—I'll be able to get out there and enjoy life again." The gift represents both practical independence and a restoration of dignity that Hanson had lost during his years without reliable wheels.
quick_facts: Navy veteran Robert Hanson served as an airman from 1993 to 1997
2020 Hyundai Elantra restored by Dunwoody College auto students in Minneapolis
Hanson had walked everywhere for over two years due to severe asthma and fibromyalgia
Vehicle donated by Allstate after major collision damage
